quotes.speaker: Gilbert Arenas
quotes.summary_phrase: Gilbert Arenas on his early basketball development in the Valley
quotes.excerpt: I learned everything early. I'm in my classroom, we got 27 kids, three blacks, three whites, ten Mexicans, El Salvadorians, Asian, Thai.
quotes.quote: I'm in the Valley growing up. So, when it was hoop time, it was international in a sense, it was a mixing pot. So, I learned everything early. I'm in my classroom, we got 27 kids, three blacks, three whites, ten Mexicans, El Salvadorians, Asian, Thai. We had everything. So, at lunchtime, we learned about everything early. You want this peanut butter and jelly? They were like, oh hell yeah. You know, you give me your Thai food, so it was cool. When it came to hooping though, just me and my Jewish friends.
